entities.summary: Amelia Rudolph Laskey was an American amateur naturalist and ornithologist noted for her contributions to the understanding of bird behavior. Many publications refer to her as Mrs F.C. Laskey. Though an autodidact without formal scientific training, she made original contributions to the field of ornithology and published in reputable scientific journals. She also mentored young naturalists, including John B. Calhoun, whose work on population dynamics was influenced by her observational methods.
